d: Long, flowing charcoal-grey hair with a smooth texture is styled with a high ponytail, long bangs, and a distinct streak of platinum-white hair framing the face. The amber-gold eyes have a sharp, focused expression, set in a youthful face with a mature air. This slender build is dressed in a white and gold high-collared outfit with a plunging neckline and dark brown fingerless gloves. Signature details include long blue and gold dangling earrings and a dark hair ornament.
